home.title: GarbellaVeus
home.p1Pre: Want to help us improve Catalan speech technology? Evaluate voice clips from the
home.p1Post: dataset, extracted from plenary session videos (CC-BY). This will let us add up to 920 hours of validated Catalan speech to the open datasets.
home.p2: It's simple: listen to the clips and vote on whether the transcription, gender, and dialect are correct. If you spot errors, you can also contribute by suggesting a more accurate transcription or identifying the correct dialect.
home.p3Link: transcriptions automatically verified by the BSC
home.p3Post: , to now add a layer of human validation on top.

about.title: About this project
about.datasetText: This platform hosts human evaluation of the Catalan YouTube Speech Corpus: 231,684 short clips of spontaneous Catalan speech, automatically extracted from public YouTube videos by Softcatalà, with audio under a CC-BY license and transcripts and metadata under MIT. Each clip includes an automatic transcription (some already filtered to higher confidence by the Barcelona Supercomputing Center), the speaker's gender and, for some clips, a detected dialect; corrections and votes from the community are collected here.
about.whyText: The transcripts were produced automatically, not reviewed by a person, so the dataset is raw and unvalidated, useful for large-scale training, but not a reliable benchmark on its own. Where the two automatic candidates agree, the text is usually trustworthy; where they diverge, the clip is often noisy, overlapping speech, or otherwise hard to transcribe.
about.goalText: Every vote you cast, on a transcription, a speaker gender, or a detected dialect, helps build a human-validated layer on top of this raw automatic data: surfacing which transcriptions can be trusted, catching what the models got wrong, and producing higher-confidence data that can be used to improve Catalan speech recognition.
